svg.title: Agentic Project Timesheet Assistant - Solution Architecture
svg.text: Agentic Project Timesheet Assistant - Solution Architecture
Local workstation - Python application, no cloud hosting
Microsoft 365 workloads, read through Microsoft Graph
inbox and Sent Items, previews only
Teams review message: disabled; writes need tenant policy.
key kept in .env, never shown in the UI
Azure and Entra icons: Microsoft Azure Architecture Icons. Mail, calendar and tools: Microsoft 365 architecture icons. Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot (used for Work IQ): Microsoft product icons.
